findings.title: WAF / Anti-Bot Mitigation Dropping Automated Probes (airindia.com)
findings.description:
The target host completed the TLS handshake (Subject: '*.airindia.com', Issuer: 'DigiCert Inc'), but subsequent automated HTTP requests were dropped or timed out by an edge Web Application Firewall (WAF) or Bot Management system ().

Because the edge security layer blackholes/drops automated scanner traffic, dynamic scanners (ZAP, Nuclei, Wapiti, Nikto) were unable to receive HTTP response payloads from the web application.

findings.remediation: To assess applications behind WAF/Anti-Bot protection: (1) Provide authenticated session cookies/tokens via the Authenticated Scan options, (2) Allowlist the Sentina scanner IP in the WAF / CDN management console, or (3) Point the assessment to the direct origin/staging endpoint.
